overview.value: The setup is simple: Shinoa, Yoichi, and Yuichirō are in a classroom or school environment. Shinoa plays a bit of mischief by giving Yuichirō a list of commands (e.g. "look at this", "turn there", etc.), via notes.

Shinoa gives Yuichirō his “heart’s desire” (or makes him pick a desired reward) — comically over the top choices. Among the items are things like silver and golden axes, and also Shinoa merchandise. Yuichirō is shown reacting/choosing one, in a humorous way.

In this episode, young Yūichirō and young Mika are having a moment in Sanguinem. Yūichirō asks Mika what’s on his mind. After some hesitation, Mika admits that he thinks he has more charm as a main character.
Shinoa and Yoichi initiate a “hand‑slap game” with Yu. A hand‑slap or slap‑tag‑type game, where Yu keeps losing each round.

They go to a library, where they find a book of secrets. They use a bitter‑tasting truth serum. As a side effect, Kimizuki and Yūichirō start behaving like dogs. They chase Yoichi around, and then fight each other.
Kimizuki is tasked with driving the squad, but he takes a wrong turn. They end up at the Saigo Takamori Statue in Ueno.
Mitsuba tries attacking Yu with several surprise moves — kicks, tickles, and other unexpected attacks. Yu tries to parry them. He struggles to keep up.
Every time Guren tries to exit or leave, somehow he ends up back in the same room. This repeats multiple times.
The Shinoa Squad is at school, and Guren is teaching them a lesson.

A lifetime of tragedy - virus attack, captivation by vampires, failed escape plan, and deaths of his family - pushes Yu to live for revenge. However, the tragedy continues as he finds out that the vampires have turned Mikaela into one of them.

Recap of the first cour of "Owari no Seraph".

A mysterious vampire named Shahal kidnaps a human girl named Riko. Shahal's true goal is unknown, and while he has kidnapped Riko, he refuses to drink her blood. Suddenly, he receives a visit from the vampire nobles Ferid and Crowley. Meanwhile, Guren tasks Shinoa Squad with rescuing Riko and returning her to her family.

Originally screened at Jump Festa 2015 events.
This episode typically shows the characters preparing or discussing strategy with humorous twists, focusing on character interactions rather than serious combat.

The characters face mishaps and misunderstandings during the battle preparations. There is plenty of humorous banter, with characters poking fun at each other’s quirks or abilities.Some gags revolve around the challenges of coordinating the squad or unexpected behavior from members.

The episode showcases funny and exaggerated character interactions, often involving playful teasing or misunderstandings. Some scenes highlight the squad’s attempts to coordinate their strategy, but things comically go off-track. There are also moments poking fun at each character’s personality quirks or habits, adding charm and levity to the storyline.

The squad tries to tackle various problems during the arc, but their efforts often lead to humorous misunderstandings or blunders. There’s playful teasing, especially between Yuichirō and other squad members like Shinoa and Kimizuki. Some moments show the squad members struggling with teamwork or getting distracted by silly things, adding to the humor.

The episode may include parodies of serious scenes from the main Nagoya Arc but with exaggerated or goofy twists.
